statements.english: Oh , they'll like me . Once they come to my awesome par-tay !
statements.chinese: 哦，他们会喜欢我的。只要他们来参加我超棒的派对！

statements.english: Okay , I gotta run . I gotta go get some nametags
statements.chinese: 好了，我得赶紧走了。我得去拿些姓名牌。

statements.english: And that crazy party animal will be your brother-in-law
statements.chinese: 而那个疯狂的派对狂人将成为你的妹夫。

statements.english: Very , very funny , but don't say things like that in front of Monica
statements.chinese: 非常非常搞笑，但别在Monica面前说这种话。

statements.english: I don't want you putting any ideas in her head
statements.chinese: 我不想让你给她灌输任何想法。

statements.english: Umm , Chandler , you do realize that those ideas
statements.chinese: 呃，Chandler，你应该意识到这些想法

statements.english: are probably already in Monica's head
statements.chinese: 可能已经在Monica的脑海里了。

statements.english: Wh-wh-why ?!
statements.chinese: 为-为-为什么？！

statements.english: Well , because she loves you and because you love her
statements.chinese: 嗯，因为她爱你，而你也爱她。
statements.phonetic: /wel/ /bɪˈkəz, bɪˈkɔːz/ /ʃiː; ʃi/ /lʌvz/ /juː; jʊ/ /ænd; ənd/ /bɪˈkəz, bɪˈkɔːz/ /juː; jʊ/ /lʌv/ /hɚ/

statements.english: Yeah , so , what's that supposed to mean ?!
statements.chinese: 啊，所以，你这话是什么意思？！

statements.english: Hey , Chandler , don't freak out !
statements.chinese: 嘿，Chandler，别慌！

statements.english: I'm telling you something you already know !
statements.chinese: 我这是在跟你说一件你早就知道的事！

statements.english: Come on , she broke up with Richard
statements.chinese: 得了吧，她和Richard分手了

statements.english: because he didn't want to have babies
statements.chinese: 因为他不想生孩子。

statements.english: And she's a woman , and she's almost 30
statements.chinese: 而且她是位女性，已经快30岁了，

statements.english: and y'know it's Monica
statements.chinese: 而且你知道的，是Monica。

statements.english: I don't see it that way . Okay ?
statements.chinese: 我不这么认为。好吗？

statements.english: Because , I see two Monicas , the one that was my friend
statements.chinese: 因为，我看到了两个Monica，那个曾经是我朋友的Monica,

statements.english: who lived across the hall , and wanted to have a lot of babies
statements.chinese: 住在对门的那位，想要生很多孩子

statements.english: and then the new Monica , who I just started to date
statements.chinese: 然后是新认识的Monica，我刚开始和她约会。

statements.english: Now , who's to say what she wants ?!
statements.chinese: 现在，谁知道她想要什么？！

wants.definition: want（第三人称单数）: 想要

statements.english: I'm right . I'm right . Am I right ?
statements.chinese: 我是对的。我是对的。我对吗？

statements.english: No , you're right , you are absolutely right
statements.chinese: 不，你是对的，你完全正确。

statements.english: I mean that makes , that makes everything different
statements.chinese: 我是说，这会让一切都变得不同。

statements.english: It's not different at all , is it ?
statements.chinese: 这根本没什么不同，不是吗？

statements.english: Not unless different means the same
statements.chinese: 除非不同意味着相同。

means.definition: mean（第三人称单数）: 意味着

statements.english: You were so funny with that waiter ! You're such a nut !
statements.chinese: 你刚才对那个服务生的样子太搞笑了！真是个活宝！

statements.english: Y'know , breadstick fangs are always funny
statements.chinese: 要知道，用面包条当獠牙总是那么滑稽。

statements.english: No , you make them funny . You're the funny one !
statements.chinese: 不，是你让它们变得有趣。你才是那个有趣的人！

statements.english: Uhh , look Katie , uh listen , we-we need to talk . Okay ?
statements.chinese: 呃，Katie，听着，我们得谈谈。好吗？

statements.english: Umm , look I like you . I-I really do , I like you a lot . Okay ?
statements.chinese: 呃，听着，我喜欢你。真的，我真的很喜欢你。好吗？

statements.english: But sometimes when you , when you playfully punch me like that
statements.chinese: 但有时候当你那样嬉闹着捶我时

statements.english: it-it feels like someone's hitting me with a very tiny
statements.chinese: 感觉像是有人在用非常小的东西敲打我

feels.definition: 感觉（第三人称单数现在时）

statements.english: but very real bat
statements.chinese: 但却是非常真实的蝙蝠。

statements.english: Aww , like I could hurt you
statements.chinese: 哎呀，好像我能伤到你似的。

statements.english: Are you making fun of my size ?
statements.chinese: 你是在嘲笑我的体型吗？

statements.english: Don't make fun of me because of my size !
statements.chinese: 别因为我的体型取笑我！

statements.english: Isn't this great ?
statements.chinese: 这难道不好吗？

statements.english: Couldn't you just stay like this forever ?
statements.chinese: 你就不能永远这样待着吗？

statements.english: Chandler ! Couldn't you just stay here forever ?
statements.chinese: Chandler！你就不能永远留在这里吗？

statements.english: Yeah , here , somewhere else , y'know where-where ever
statements.chinese: 是啊，这里，或者其他什么地方，你懂的——随便哪个地方都行。

statements.english: Are you okay ?
statements.chinese: 你还好吗？

statements.english: Yeah , I'm cool . Casual
statements.chinese: 嗯，我还好。随便吧。

statements.english: What-what are you doing ?
statements.chinese: 你-你在干什么？

statements.english: I'm just hanging out . Y'know , having fun
statements.chinese: 我就是随便逛逛，你懂的，找点乐子。

statements.english: Y'know with the girl that I'm seeing casually
statements.chinese: 你知道的，就是和我约会但关系未定的那个女孩。

that.definition: 那个（关系代词的作用说明）

statements.english: Man , I knew it ! I knew you were going to do this !!
statements.chinese: 老兄，我就知道！我就知道你会来这一套！！

were.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: What ?!
statements.chinese: 什么？！

statements.english: Get all freaked out because everybody was talking
statements.chinese: 因为大家都在议论而变得惊慌失措

freaked.definition: freak（过去分词）: 使极度兴奋或不安

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: and just joking around about marriage and stuff
statements.chinese: 还开玩笑地聊了聊婚姻之类的事情。

statements.english: Well , you do want all that stuff , right ?
statements.chinese: 嗯，你确实想要那些东西，对吧？

statements.english: Oh and you know what I want !
statements.chinese: 哦，你知道我想要什么！

statements.english: Yes ! You want babies ! You have baby fever !
statements.chinese: 没错！你想要宝宝！你得了婴儿狂热症！

statements.english: I do not have baby fever !
statements.chinese: 我可没有生娃焦虑！

do.definition: 助动词，用于构成否定句或疑问句

statements.english: Oh please , you are obsessed with babies and-and marriage
statements.chinese: 拜托，你满脑子都是宝宝啊结婚啊这些事

obsessed.definition: 着迷（过去分词）: 着迷

statements.english: and everything that's related to babies and-and marriage !
statements.chinese: 以及所有与婴儿和婚姻相关的一切！

statements.english: I've got an good idea
statements.chinese: 我有个好主意,

statements.english: why don't we turn down the heat on this pressure cooker ?!
statements.chinese: 我们何不给这个高压锅降降温呢？！

statements.english: Have you lost your mind ?
statements.chinese: 你疯了吗？

statements.english: Chandler , this isn't about me ! This is about you
statements.chinese: Chandler，这不是关于我的事！这是关于你的

statements.english: and all your weird relationship commitment crap !
statements.chinese: 还有你那些关于恋爱承诺的古怪破事！

statements.english: Nah-uh ! I know you ! Okay ?
statements.chinese: 才不是！我认识你！懂吗？

statements.english: I know the thoughts that you have in the head–in your head !
statements.chinese: 我知道你脑子里——在你脑袋里转的念头！

that.definition: 那个（关系代词，引导定语从句）

statements.english: You don't know everything
statements.chinese: 你并非无所不知。

statements.english: Did you know that I'm going out with Rachel tonight instead of you ?
statements.chinese: 你知道吗，今晚我要和Rachel约会，而不是你。

Did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: And did you know that the only baby around here is you ?!
statements.chinese: 你难道不知道这里唯一的小宝贝就是你吗？！

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

is.definition: be（现在时）: 构成现在时

statements.english: And did you know that I can't even look at you right now ?!
statements.chinese: 你知道吗，我现在甚至都不敢看你一眼？！

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: Well , I did not know that
statements.chinese: 好吧，我还真不知道这事。

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句或否定句

statements.english: It's gonna be okay , right ? I mean she's not gonna leave me ?
statements.chinese: 一切都会好起来的，对吧？我是说，她不会离开我的对吗？

statements.english: This is , this is fixable
statements.chinese: 这是可以补救的。

statements.english: Oh yeah , yeah , sure . Absolutely
statements.chinese: 哦对，对，当然。完全正确。
